section_summary: This section covers State Department correspondence from June to August 1947 regarding travel regulations, military entry permits, and exit clearances for occupied Japan. It features diplomatic exchanges with foreign embassies acknowledging exit permit waivers, requests for missionary and compassionate travel, inquiries from businessmen and consulates concerning the resumption of private trade, and procedures for Japanese voluntary repatriates. A major component is State-War-Navy Coordinating Committee policy paper SWNCC 348 governing the interchange of cultural, educational, scientific, and religious persons between Japan and other nations.

subfiles.about: Concluding portion of a Department of State note concerning entry clearance for Irish nuns entering Japan.
subfiles.summary: States that the Irish Department of External Affairs is understood to have furnished information regarding the nuns' entry permission.
subfiles.title: Department of State Note Regarding Permission for Irish Nuns to Enter Japan

subfiles.about: Discussion with Commander Millett regarding a transit permit through Japan for Mrs. Mei Li Tong Chen and children.
subfiles.summary: Millett agreed to issue transit permits for the Chinese nationals and noted proposed consular authority for transit visas.
subfiles.title: Memorandum of Conversation on Transit Permit for Mrs. Mei Li Tong Chen

subfiles.about: Record of receipt of Military Permit No. 17649 for Mrs. Chen and her two children.

subfiles.summary: Instructs that action proceed based on file copies since the main file had not returned to SPD.

subfiles.about: Transmittal of Military Permit No. 17649 and passport for Mrs. Mei Li Tong Chen and her children.

subfiles.about: Request for issuance of a military transit permit through Japan for Mrs. Chen and her two children.
subfiles.summary: Encloses Chinese Embassy note requesting transit permit for Mrs. Chen and children during Tokyo plane refueling stop.

subfiles.to: Commander John R. Millett (Joint Chiefs of Staff)

subfiles.about: Preliminary reply acknowledging request for transit permit for Mrs. Chen and her children.

subfiles.title: Department of State Note to Chinese Ambassador Acknowledging Transit Request

subfiles.about: Record note acknowledging receipt of information regarding entry control into Japan.
subfiles.summary: Records acknowledgment of State Department note of May 17 regarding entry control of individuals into Japan.

subfiles.about: Acknowledgment of circular note regarding waiver of exit permits for aliens departing to Japan.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges State Department note of May 16 concerning waiver of exit permits for aliens traveling to Japan.

subfiles.about: Acknowledgment of circular note of May 17 regarding new provisions for travel to Japan.

subfiles.about: Acknowledgment of circular note of May 16 concerning exit permit waiver for travel to Japan.

subfiles.about: Uruguayan inquiry regarding sending a trade representative or liaison officer to Japan.

subfiles.title: Airgram No. 236 from Montevideo Regarding Uruguayan Trade Representation in Japan

subfiles.about: Department reply regarding procedure for admitting an Uruguayan trade representative to Japan.

subfiles.about: Transmittal of memorandum concerning Nuri Tacla and his son.

subfiles.about: Investigating missing record of January 23 memorandum regarding clearance for Maria Dajkovich.
subfiles.summary: Details inter-agency checks with CAD and Visa Division to locate previous entry clearance records for Maria Dajkovich.
subfiles.title: Memorandum for the Files Regarding Maria Dajkovich Entry Clearance

subfiles.about: Routing slip regarding control of entry into Japan.
subfiles.summary: Internal routing slip referencing entry control into Japan stamped by Japanese and Korean Economic Affairs.

subfiles.about: Acknowledgment of circular note of May 16 regarding entry permits into Japan.

subfiles.about: Acknowledgment of circular of May 16 regarding military entry permission for Japan.

subfiles.about: Record copy replacement sheet for missing yellow action copy filed under 894.111/6-647.
subfiles.summary: Replacement sheet designating record copy to replace unreturned yellow action copy for file 894.111/6-647.

subfiles.about: Permitting entry of K. U. Dunn into Japan to claim his brother's remains.

subfiles.about: Internal discussion distinguishing Edward Sandrock from earlier Charles Sandrock case.

subfiles.title: Internal Office Notes Regarding Application of Edward Sandrock

subfiles.about: Recommending approval of military permit for French missionary Edward Sandrock to teach in Yokohama.

subfiles.about: Acknowledgment of circular note of May 16 regarding procedures for travel to Japan.

subfiles.title: Dominican Embassy Note Acknowledging Travel Regulations Circular

subfiles.about: Acknowledgment of circular note regarding waiver of exit permits for travel to Japan.

subfiles.about: Acknowledgment of note regarding modified procedure for requesting military entry permits into Japan.
subfiles.summary: Mexican Embassy acknowledges note regarding modified procedures for military entry into Japan; includes English translation.
subfiles.title: Mexican Embassy Note No. 2993 Acknowledging Entry Procedures Circular

subfiles.about: Informal notes on departure date and vessel for six Irish nuns.
subfiles.summary: Notes sailing date of July 11 on SS General Meigs and references NCWC coordination.
subfiles.title: Handwritten File Note Concerning Travel of Irish Nuns

subfiles.about: Telephone discussions with Irish Legation and JCS regarding permit validity extension for Irish nuns.
subfiles.summary: Discusses extending permit validity to August 15 because nuns sail July 11 arriving Yokohama July 27.
subfiles.title: Memorandum of Conversation on Permit Validity Extension for Six Irish Nuns

subfiles.about: Formal request to extend entry permit validity for six Irish nuns to August 15, 1947.
subfiles.summary: Requests JCS extend validity period of entry permits for six Irish nuns sailing on SS General Meigs.
subfiles.title: Letter from Richard E. Hibbard to Commander Millett Requesting Extension for Nuns
subfiles.to: Commander John R. Millett (Joint Chiefs of Staff)

subfiles.about: Request for entry permit extension and clarification regarding inclusion of food in baggage for nuns.
subfiles.summary: Requests extension of entry permits to July 27 and inquires if nuns may bring food supplies to Japan.
subfiles.title: Irish Legation Note Requesting Extension and Inquiring on Food Shipments

subfiles.about: Informing Irish Legation of permit extension to August 15 and enclosing missionary food regulations.
subfiles.summary: Confirms permit extension to August 15, explains conditions for shipping food in missionary baggage, and references NCWC Bureau of Immigration.
subfiles.title: Department of State Note to Irish Minister Granting Extension and Explaining Food Rules

subfiles.about: Instructions regarding commercial entry applications for Roy Clinton Farrell and Arthur Walter Hogan.
subfiles.summary: Provides instructions on handling entry applications for Farrell and Hogan, noting Philippine quota requirements and forthcoming trade circular.
subfiles.title: Telegram No. 594 to Hong Kong on Commercial Entry Applications

subfiles.about: Requesting instructions on procedures for businessmen seeking entry into Japan under new regulations.
subfiles.summary: Reports numerous inquiries from businessmen wishing to visit Japan and requests Department instructions under newly announced regulations.
subfiles.title: Airgram No. A-73 from Hong Kong Requesting Instructions on Commercial Travel

subfiles.about: Transmitting Argentine request regarding repatriation of Alfonso Sumio Fushimi and Julio Hideo Fushimi.
subfiles.summary: Transmits Argentine note requesting departure assistance for Argentine citizens Alfonso Sumio and Julio Hideo Fushimi in Takamatsu.
subfiles.title: Instruction to US Political Adviser, Tokyo, Regarding Fushimi Brothers
subfiles.to: United States Political Adviser to SCAP, Tokyo

subfiles.about: Acknowledging Argentine note regarding repatriation of Alfonso Sumio and Julio Hideo Fushimi.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges note requesting exit permission for Fushimi brothers and confirms forwarding inquiry to US Political Adviser in Tokyo.
subfiles.title: Department of State Note to Argentine Ambassador Regarding Fushimi Brothers

subfiles.about: Requesting departure clearance and repatriation assistance for native Argentine citizens Alfonso Sumio and Julio Hideo Fushimi.
subfiles.summary: Requests occupation assistance to permit Alfonso Sumio and Julio Hideo Fushimi to leave Japan, guaranteeing Argentine government payment of expenses.
subfiles.title: Argentine Embassy Note D.E. No. 271 Regarding Departure of Fushimi Brothers

subfiles.about: Inquiring about trade entry procedures for Hawaiian merchants of Japanese ancestry and Japanese nationals.
subfiles.from: John F. Alexander (Territory of Hawaii Attorney General's Office)
subfiles.summary: Inquires about trade application procedures for Hawaii merchants and eligibility of Japanese nationals residing in the United States.
subfiles.title: Letter from John F. Alexander Regarding Japan Trade Entry for Hawaii Residents

subfiles.about: Providing Commerce and State Department press releases regarding business travel and trade with Japan.
subfiles.summary: Encloses press releases outlining application procedures for businessmen, advising Hawaii applicants to apply directly to Office of International Trade.
subfiles.title: Letter from Thayer White to John F. Alexander on Business Travel Procedures

subfiles.about: Comprehensive policy paper approving and outlining procedures for the cultural, educational, scientific, and religious interchange of persons with Japan.
subfiles.summary: SWNCC paper 348 establishes policy governing the interchange of educators, religious workers, scientists, and trade unionists with occupied Japan. Approved at the 58th SWNCC meeting, it specifies sponsorship criteria, financial expense rules, clearance channels, and general directives governing missionary entry and reorientation programs.
subfiles.title: SWN-5501 and SWNCC 348: Policy for the Interchange of Persons Between Japan and Other Countries

subfiles.about: Transmitting SWNCC 348 conclusions for submission to the Far Eastern Commission as US policy.
subfiles.from: J. H. Hilldring (Assistant Secretary of State)
subfiles.summary: Requests the US Member submit SWNCC 348 conclusions to the Commission while advising that housing and food shortages may delay visits.
subfiles.title: Department of State Memorandum Transmitting SWNCC 348 to US Member, Far Eastern Commission
subfiles.to: United States Member, Far Eastern Commission

subfiles.about: Routing memorandum SWN-5501 for signature of General Hilldring.
subfiles.summary: Routing slip for memorandum to the Secretary of State regarding SWNCC 348 for signature of General Hilldring.
subfiles.title: Routing Slip for SWN-5501 Regarding SWNCC 348

subfiles.about: Transmitting applications of Eugene Elias, Roy Clinton Farrell, and Arthur Walter Hogan to enter Japan.

subfiles.title: Airgram No. A-76 from Hong Kong Transmitting Business Entry Applications

subfiles.about: Drafting notes concerning customs and baggage rules for voluntary Japanese repatriates.
subfiles.summary: Internal draft notes regarding instructing Tokyo to inform Japanese customs authorities of financial and baggage regulations for repatriates.
subfiles.title: Internal Handwritten Notes on Voluntary Repatriate Customs Information

subfiles.about: Authorizing shipment of personal motor vehicles to Japan by repatriated Japanese.

subfiles.title: Incoming Clear Message Z 39463 Regarding Shipment of Motor Vehicles by Repatriates

subfiles.about: JCS confirmation of no objection to extending entry permits for six Irish nuns to August 15, 1947.
subfiles.from: Lucile A. Flickinger (Joint Chiefs of Staff)
subfiles.summary: States the Joint Chiefs of Staff have no objection to extending entry permits to August 15 for six Irish nuns.

subfiles.about: Charge slip recording checkout of letter to Leo Hatzman.

subfiles.title: Department of State Charge Slip Concerning Leo Hatzman File

subfiles.about: Transmitting financial and baggage information sheets for voluntary Japanese repatriates.
subfiles.summary: Transmits information sheets on financial regulations and baggage export to be provided to Japanese customs authorities for voluntary repatriates.
subfiles.title: Instruction to US Political Adviser, Tokyo, Transmitting Repatriate Regulations
subfiles.to: United States Political Adviser to SCAP, Tokyo

subfiles.about: Inquiring about procedures for Turkish representative Arthur Braun to travel to Japan on commercial business.
subfiles.from: Siber Hegner & Co., Inc. (Hans Vaterlaus / W. A. Stutz)
subfiles.summary: Inquires how Turkish agent Arthur Braun may obtain permission to visit Japan to resume commercial business in chinaware.
subfiles.title: Letter from Siber Hegner & Co. Concerning Business Travel of Arthur Braun

subfiles.about: Explaining passport and military permit application procedures for Turkish national Arthur Braun.
subfiles.from: Melville H. Walker (Division of Japanese and Korean Economic Affairs)
subfiles.summary: Advises that Braun must apply through Turkish government for passport and military permit, noting travel starts August 15.
subfiles.title: Letter from Melville H. Walker to W. A. Stutz on Business Travel Procedures
subfiles.to: W. A. Stutz (Siber Hegner & Co., Inc.)
